title: Example 17-7: Unmarked Errors to be Identified

illustrates.quote: Unmarked Errors. When entire passages have unmarked intentional spelling errors that are to be identified and/or corrected by the reader, transcribe them in uncontracted braille.

blocks.text: `today I wint shopping for new shoes? The weather has turned verry cold for Easter. Lets go for icecream. Please! wash your hands before make the sandwich.`

print.notes: An entire passage with several unmarked intentional spelling errors ('wint', 'verry', 'icecream', 'equell'-style errors), no font attribute calling them out.
surroundingText: (See Sample 17-12: Unmarked Intentional Spelling Errors on page 17-25.)
